William Shakespeare, Twelfth Night.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-shakespeare/twelfth-night

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Shakespeare, the author, died 1616.

First publication of the text used: 1601 (SE colophon: 'Twelfth Night was published in 1601 by William Shakespeare.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1601, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the country of first publication does not change the result. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1616 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Twelfth Night was published in 1601 by William Shakespeare.
- Wikidata Q692 (William Shakespeare), P570 = 1616-04-23, 1616-05-03
